examples.name: Counter-sample — 3samehead
paragraphs: A plausible value substituted for the printed one. The page prints 32031.9% for the 2004+ % of Premium cell; the non-conforming output records 10.9%. The wrong value is the believable one — exactly the failure this rule prevents. The section lines (Issue Year, Issue Age) are bands across the grid.
